# 📋 Install flame effect system

- **Checklist types:** Build
- **Area:** Propane area
- **When:** During Build after the supporting structure passes inspection

## What you need

- Flame Lead, Power Lead, and trained flame crew
- 📦 Build Book — At the build station. Current camp-specific build and strike drawings, part counts, connection details, anchor locations, crew requirements, lift sequence, and final-state photographs for each structure.
- 📦 Camp Map — Posted in the communal kitchen. Current camp map showing task areas, service lanes, emergency exits, and private infrastructure.
- 📋 Inspect flame effect system
- 🔥 Flame Effect System — Propane area (see the map). Registered Treble Makers propane flame effect, including its structure, cylinders, hoses, fittings, regulators, valves, pilots, accumulators, controls, and effect heads.
- 🔥 Zimmer Vaporizer — Propane area (see the map). Camp propane vaporizer identified as Zimmer in the source checklist, including its tank valve, relief valve, voltage display, thermocouples, and effect feeds.
- 🔥 Flame Effect Operating Procedure — At the flame-effect operator station. Current Flame Lead-approved system sheet naming every valve and control and stating the validated voltage, temperature, pressure, timing, startup, shutdown, and emergency-shutdown values for the actual installation.
- 🔥 Flame Effect Burn License — Physically held by the licensed operator while the effect is operated. Current FAST-issued physical burn license for this flame effect.
- 🔥 Propane Leak Test Solution — Propane area. EASTMAN 65700B liquid gas leak detector, 2 oz, for LP-gas fittings.
- 🔥 Flame Effect SDS — At the flame-effect operator station. Current safety data sheet for propane and each hazardous chemical at the installation.
- 📦 Fire Extinguishers — At the locations marked on 📦 Camp Map. Camp fire extinguishers mounted near identified fire hazards.

## Ready before normal use

- **📦 Build Book:** The page for the current asset is complete and approved by the responsible lead.
- **🔥 Flame Effect Operating Procedure:** The current revision is legible and approved by the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Propane Leak Test Solution:** Enough solution is available for every connection being tested.
- **📦 Fire Extinguishers:** The gauge is in the operable range and access is clear.

## Steps

1. Confirm that the installation drawing and operating procedure match the FAST-submitted flame-effect scenario.
2. Install every rated fuel component in the exact drawing location and orientation.
3. Install the single labeled quarter-turn emergency shutoff in its approved visible location.
4. Secure every cylinder upright and protect the installation from vehicle traffic.
5. Establish the FAST-approved audience perimeter and 20-foot combustible-free zone.
6. Have the Power Lead install de-energized electrical components according to the approved drawing.
7. Perform the pre-inspection leak test according to 🔥 Flame Effect Operating Procedure under the Flame Lead and any required FAST supervision.
   - **IF/THEN:** IF any connection fails, THEN keep the system out of service until the Flame Lead corrects and retests it.
8. Have FAST physically inspect the completed installation.
   - **IF/THEN:** IF FAST does not approve the installation, THEN do not test or operate it.
9. Place the issued 🔥 Flame Effect Burn License with the licensed operator.
10. Complete 📋 Inspect flame effect system.

## PASS when

- The installation matches the FAST-submitted drawing and uses only rated components.
- The emergency shutoff, cylinder securement, vehicle protection, and approved perimeter are complete.
- No leak is present.
- FAST approved the physical installation and issued the current burn license.
- 📋 Inspect flame effect system passes.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **📦 Build Book:** The book remains complete and at the build station.
- **📦 Camp Map:** The current map is posted, readable, and unobstructed.
- **🔥 Flame Effect System:** The system is either under continuous licensed operation or fully shut down according to its approved operating procedure.
- **🔥 Zimmer Vaporizer:** The vaporizer is either under continuous licensed operation or fully shut down according to its approved operating procedure.
- **🔥 Flame Effect Operating Procedure:** The procedure remains at the operator station.
- **🔥 Flame Effect Burn License:** The license is returned to the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Propane Leak Test Solution:** The cap is closed and the bottle is stored upright.
- **🔥 Flame Effect SDS:** Every current sheet is legible and available to responders.
- **📦 Fire Extinguishers:** Each extinguisher is mounted, visible, unobstructed, and in the operable range.

### If an item is not ready

- **📦 Build Book:** Do not build, alter, or strike the affected asset. Tell the Build Lead.
- **🔥 Flame Effect System:** Do not operate the system. Tell the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Zimmer Vaporizer:** Do not energize or open fuel to the vaporizer. Tell the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Flame Effect Operating Procedure:** Do not operate the flame effect. Tell the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Flame Effect Burn License:** Do not test or operate the flame effect. Tell the Flame Lead.
- **🔥 Propane Leak Test Solution:** Ask the Propane Lead for replacement leak-test solution.
- **📦 Fire Extinguishers:** Tell the Dominatrix immediately.

## Common problems

- **🔥 Propane Leak Test Solution:** **IF** The applied solution forms growing bubbles **THEN** Close the fuel supply, keep the equipment out of service, and tell the Propane Lead. Never use a flame to test for a leak.

## Who to ask

Flame Lead
